groups.name: Text glyph icons
groups.definition: Are icons rendered as text glyphs or emoji rather than image, sprite, or icon-font icons?

groups.name: Descriptive image alt text
groups.definition: Do images carry descriptive, human-readable alt text naming their content or item?

groups.name: Empty alt on decorative images
groups.definition: Is alt text empty for decorative images or thumbnails while hero or people images have descriptive alt?

groups.name: Rounded or circular image crops
groups.definition: Are images cropped into circles or rounded-corner tiles or cards?

groups.name: Uniform square-cropped images
groups.definition: Are images or thumbnails cropped to uniform sizes or aspect ratios (square, tall) across cards?

groups.name: Repeated placeholder or reused images
groups.definition: Is the same image or placeholder reused repeatedly in multiple tiles or places?

groups.name: Color blocks replace images
groups.definition: Are images replaced by flat or gradient color blocks or neutral gray placeholders instead of photos?

groups.name: Logo sizing and repetition
groups.definition: Are logos large or repeated, or low-visibility (light logos on white tiles falling back to text)?

groups.name: Darkened or color-overlaid photo backgrounds
groups.definition: Do hero or feature sections use full-bleed photos or artwork with a dark or colored overlay behind text?

groups.name: Distorted or oversized images
groups.definition: Are images stretched, distorted, or oversized so they break an otherwise uniform layout?

groups.name: Photos on collection cards
groups.definition: Are photographs used as card imagery with product or item lists beneath them?

groups.name: Uniform icon sizing in cards
groups.definition: Are icons sized uniformly (about 60px) and styled consistently within cards?

groups.name: CSS background images for photos
groups.definition: Are photos shown as CSS background images rather than img elements?

groups.name: No photographic imagery
groups.definition: Does the page lack photographs or illustrative images, using only dark gradient backgrounds, text cards, logos and badges?
